title: Value of the macSecretBase64 field
summary: A synthetic Base64 value, padding included, after the exact macSecretBase64 field name in a JSON response, a YAML configuration and a shell-style assignment.
rationale: Creating an Airtable webhook returns the MAC secret in the macSecretBase64 field; the receiver decodes it to verify the HMAC of later deliveries. The field name is the carrier. Airtable states no width for the value, so none is claimed. The extent is the complete encoded text, padding included, and not the decoded bytes, which do not occur in the source.

expectation.rationale: Flagged under project policy: the encoded value of the exact macSecretBase64 field is treated as a credential and covered in full. Airtable documents the field and its role in verification (carrier existence only); the exact field-name policy, value admission and extent are the project's decisions. The policy does not extend to other fields whose names end in Base64.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy. Parser behaviour, action and product attribution stay with the downstream repositories.
